method: 3D physical continuous surface, perspective inverse projection, bilinear texture sampling, analytic front-face and self-occlusion tests, independent Blender camera re-render

verification.criterion: composition opening must be within the visible screen; interior and artwork mean absolute sRGB error <= 0.04; >=98% independently rendered artwork silhouette covered by visible screen

limitations: Nominal geometry is not field calibration; measured camera pose, lens distortion and LED transfer response are required on site.
Pixels outside the camera frustum or occluded/back-facing physical surface are black.
Comparison excludes a one-pixel raster boundary; texture resampling and finite curved mesh tessellation contribute remaining error.

coordinate_system.physical_surface: studio.geometry.surface_point; centered X bounds; yaw about Z

autumn.poster_light_link: artistic approximation of three source-poster light regions

timing.sample_time: actual: index / fps; nominal reference: index / count * 7.5

verification_summary.note: All frames have solid-envelope geometry and actual 3D source renders; independent LED camera and coverage checks are sampled.
